u.0.1.31.3.s: LYNX SHARE 0.1.31.3 fixes two safety problems: .flp exports that FL Studio could play as a full-scale constant signal, and saves on a full disk that replaced the file with a cut-off copy. Re-export .flp files made with 0.1.31 to 0.1.31.2 that use song-start values on plugin controls.
u.0.1.31.3.f0: Export to FL Studio: in 0.1.31 to 0.1.31.2, a plugin control's song-start value ("Init song with this position", common in FL projects opened in LYNX) went out on the wrong scale, and FL could play the exported song as a full-scale constant signal (FL 2026 did with the demo Thief), loud enough to hurt ears and speakers. It now goes out on the plugin's own scale. Re-export such .flp files, and turn the volume down before you open an older export in FL.
u.0.1.31.3.f1: In every release since 0.1.30, saving on a full disk (or a failing or unplugged drive) replaced the project with a cut-off file; exports, backups and settings files too. LYNX now replaces a file only after the new one is written whole and has reached the disk; otherwise the original stays exactly as it was and LYNX says why ("Not saved: the disk is full. Your project file was not changed.").
